rationale: Phase 4 infrastructure: eval-diagnostician + changelog created, runner mock_data substitution implemented

author: human
rationale: LangChain Better-Harness recommended: domain-defining questions before implementation questions. Remaining automated failures need live execution (runner v1 limitation), not prompt changes.

before: Harness path selected when step-level logs are needed.
after: Harness is the strict path only; plan conversion uses scripts/harness-convert.ps1; existing phases skip conversion; preflight uses scripts/harness-doctor.ps1; step execution uses scripts/harness-run.ps1 with timeout/progress logging; wiring gates use scripts/harness-gate.ps1; status/reset use scripts/harness-phase.ps1; smoke flow uses scripts/harness-smoke.ps1; Matt Pocock skill mapping is documented in docs/reference/mattpocock-harness-adapter.md; failure recovery requires a concrete Verify/runtime/wiring signal.
author: codex
rationale: Make EZPowers harness lighter and more usable by applying Matt Pocock feedback-loop-first, vertical-slice, and architecture-depth principles while keeping EZPowers automation as the source of truth.

before: Long procedure manuals in setup, brainstorm, plan, and executeharness command prompts.
after: Short controller prompts with Purpose, Read, Rules, Stop conditions, and Outputs; long schemas and templates moved to docs/reference/setup-contract.md, docs/reference/spec-contract.md, docs/reference/plan-contract.md, and docs/reference/harness-execution-contract.md; scripts/check-harness-docs.ps1 validates the prompt diet contract.
author: codex
rationale: Reduce EZPowers prompt surface area while keeping phase state, reviewer dispatch, harness helpers, and automated gates as the source of truth.

before: Eval corpus, schema, baseline, plugin metadata, and eval command docs could drift independently.
after: Eval sync validation enforces schema/index/baseline/plugin alignment; stale eval graders target canonical contracts; golden baseline gate blocks failing baseline writes.
author: codex
rationale: Release the validation-normalization work as a plugin update without weakening expected plugin behavior.

before: Subagent and inline execution relied on procedural prompt checks for Verify, runtime smoke, and full-feature wiring completion.
after: Lightpath execution uses scripts/lightpath-gate.ps1 plus shared harness helpers so task Verify, runtime smoke, wiring gate evidence, and reviewer verdicts are fail-closed like the harness path.
author: codex
rationale: Make subagent-driven execution mechanically enforce the same verification level as harness execution while keeping parent-controller context small.

before: Setup, brainstorm, and plan could omit frontend, backend, packaging, and deployment delivery surfaces unless the user explicitly raised them.
after: App delivery is a first-class contract: setup records app_delivery, brainstorm emits an App Experience And Delivery Baseline, plan carries an Experience/Delivery Matrix, task surfaces require delivery verification, pipeline-audit has D9 App Delivery Readiness, and validation avoids Git Bash backtick expansion for simple Python graders.
author: codex
rationale: Make greenfield app planning cover frontend, backend, packaging, and deployment from design through verification.

before: Plugin metadata was published at 1.6.4 while marketplace metadata still advertised 1.6.2.
after: Claude, Codex, and marketplace plugin metadata all advertise 1.6.5.
author: codex
rationale: Force plugin update detection after the previous behavioral commit reused an already-installed version number.

before: Completed tasks and final lightpath status could be represented by controller state without a durable per-task AC proof ledger.
after: Task-level Verify evidence is written to task-gates/task-N.json, final completion requires completion-certificate.json PASS, resume treats checked tasks without proof as needs_verification, and plugin metadata advertises 1.6.6.
author: codex
rationale: Make task AC verification machine-checkable so master-session prose or plan checkboxes cannot substitute for executed Verify evidence.

before: Public flow exposed /brainstorm, /plan, /choiceexecutor, /executeharness, and /pipeline-audit as top-level commands; setup created project slots but had no explicit verified local kit contract.
after: Public flow is /setup -> /design_architecture -> /spec -> /prepare_execute -> /choice_execute, lifecycle commands add /maintain, /deploy, and /reset_setup, strict execution and audit are internal adapters, setup/reset setup install a no-synthesis local kit, and UI verification is adapter-capability based.
author: codex
rationale: Simplify harness usage while preserving fail-closed verification and preventing setup from installing diluted synthesized skill content.

before: Desktop runtime evidence passed when runtime-probe.json reported status=completed and exit_code=0, even without screenshot, UI, or API observation evidence.
after: Desktop runtime evidence requires desktop_evidence with a window signal, screenshot path, pixel variance, and UI or API observation before reviewer PASS can produce a final wiring gate pass.
author: codex
rationale: Close the latent desktop wiring blind spot exposed by v2 strict helper reuse and align mechanical gates with the reviewer and pipeline-audit contracts.

before: Server/API observation was enforced only inside desktop runtime evidence, so web/mobile/GUI client-server wiring could pass with reviewer PASS and no API-derived client observation.
after: Client-server wiring evidence is enforced across client surfaces through client_server_evidence.api_observation or backward-compatible desktop_evidence.api_observation before reviewer PASS can produce a final wiring gate pass.
author: codex
rationale: Generalize the runtime/wiring gate from a desktop-only evidence rule to the actual client-server wiring defect while preserving CLI/server/library behavior.

before: Changelog entries stopped at 2.0.3; releases 2.0.4-2.0.8 (reviewer placement gate hardening, harness resume and frontend readiness hardening, reference doc syncs, CLAUDE.md context trim, 2.0.8 static baseline) were shipped without append-only log entries.
after: Catch-up entry records the unlogged 2.0.4-2.0.8 release window from git history; per-release logging resumes with the 3.0.0 modernization entries.
author: claude-fable-5
rationale: Restore append-only continuity before the 3.0.0 commands-to-skills migration so version archaeology does not dead-end at 2.0.3.

before: Workflow commands lived in commands/*.md (legacy custom-command format): invisible to Codex without the ezpowers-workflow adapter, and choice_execute carried 1,024 lines with gate rules duplicated against verification-contract.
after: 13 workflow commands migrated to skills/<name>/SKILL.md (Agent Skills standard) with disable-model-invocation and per-skill openai.yaml explicit-invocation policy; four names hyphenated for the standard; ezpowers-workflow adapter and the plugins/ezpowers mirror retired; choice-execute dieted to 629 lines with procedures re-homed into verification-contract.
author: claude-fable-5
rationale: Modernize to the current Claude Code skills format and give Codex first-class discovery of every workflow without a manual adapter.
